S. B. R.
No. S & D.
Date ____

194

50,000 Wang Ching-wei Troops
Reported Massed Near Shanghai

Well Equipped Soldiers Said Arrived Here
Secretly From Nanking: Precautions
Continue In Concession

Fears that Wang Ching-wei might be contemplating a
seizure of the foreign areas in Shanghai, rose today on a
report from an ordinarily reliable Chinese source that 50,000
soldiers belonging to Wang Ching-wei's troops have arrived
secretly here.

The troops, according to the Chinese report, are mostly
from the Nanking area and are fairly equipped with arms
and artillery equipment.

Seizure Rumored

The arrival of the troops was
said to have followed the news of
developments in the European war,
when it was first rumored that
seizure of the French Concession
was being planned by Wang
Ching-wei's Japanese-sponsored
regime at Nanking.

At the same time it has been
learned that stringent precautions
are being taken in the French
Concession to prevent any un-
toward development. Officials de-
clared that various duties in the
Concession were being continued
in a normal way.

Officials Reticent

Regarding future developments
French officials were reticent, al-
though it was stated that for the
present matters would remain
entirely unchanged.

With news from Europe still
uncertain main local interest con-
tinued to focus today on pos-
sible developments in Europe
rather than in local problems.

A Japanese embassy spokesman,
questioned in connection with a
rumor that Japan would take
direct action against the foreign
areas of Shanghai, stated that
the rumor was entirely unfound-
ed. He declared, however, that
some action might be taken on
the part of Japan in the event
of an "extraordinary change
in the situation" in Europe.

Other Chinese sources, how-
ever, declared that the troops may
not be more than 20,000 and
that their arrival had no political
implications. A few hundred
have arrived in Wusong and are
stationed at the airport, while
others are said to be near the
Yangtze River.

（批：20 6/10）

194

五万名汪精卫部队
据报集结于上海附近

据悉装备精良的士兵已从南京秘密抵达此处：租界内继续采取预防措施

今日，据一位通常可靠的中方消息来源报告，五万名隶属于汪精卫部队的士兵已秘密抵达此地，由此引发了人们对汪精卫可能正谋划夺取上海外国区域的担忧。

据中方报告称，这些部队大多来自南京地区，并配备了相当充足的武器和火炮装备。

传闻企图夺取

据说，这支部队的抵达紧随欧洲战事发展的消息之后，当时首次有谣言称，汪精卫在南京的日本扶持政权正计划夺取法租界。

与此同时，获悉法租界内正采取严格的预防措施，以防止任何意外事态发生。官员们宣称，租界内的各项职责正以正常方式继续履行。

官员保持缄默

关于未来的发展，法国官员保持缄默，尽管据称目前局势将完全保持不变。

由于来自欧洲的消息仍不确定，今天当地的主要关注点继续集中在欧洲可能出现的局势发展上，而非本地问题。

日本大使馆发言人在被问及有关日本将对上海外国区域采取直接行动的谣言时，表示该谣言毫无根据。然而，他声明，如果欧洲局势发生“非凡变化”，日本方面可能会采取某些行动。

然而，其他中方消息人士声称，部队人数可能不超过两万人，且他们的到来没有政治含义。数百人已抵达吴淞并驻扎在机场，而其他人员据称位于长江附近。

（批注：20 6/10）

CHINA PRESS

Italian Ships
Find Refuge
Above Boom

Three Chinese-Italian Navigation Company steamers found safety of neutral waters several days ago, tying up above the Nantao boom, in preparation for the eventuality of Italy entering the war against the Allies, THE CHINA PRESS learned yesterday.

The s.s. Amba Alagi, chartered by Jardines, moved down to berth a short way off the s.s. Ramses, German steamer which was trapped in port by the outbreak of the European war and which has ever since been safe in the neutral part of the Whangpoo. A short distance away are moored the s.s. Hinderta, currently chartered by John Manners —which moved down yesterday—and the s.s. Granatiera Padova.

Emanuele Carlotta, an Italian gunboat, also moved down to berth inside Nantao boom.

Conte Verde Avoids Hongkong

The fact that the Lloyd Triestino express liner Conte Verde will call on Shanghai after a straight run from Manila, without calling at Hongkong as she usually did further strengthened the belief that Italy was preparing to enter the war.

The s.s. Tientsin, also a Chinese-Italian Navigation Company steamer, meanwhile, is moored opposite Pootung Road and is due to weigh anchor for Chinkiang, just off Woosung, at 4 p.m. today.

The Lepanto, Italian gunboat, will then be the only ship carrying the Italian flag at anchor in the neutral part of the Whangpoo below the Bund. The Lepanto is berthed at the Japanese Naval Base.

《字林西报》

意大利船只
在拦江浮栅上方
找到避难所

《字林西报》昨日获悉，几天前，三艘中意轮船公司的蒸汽船为了应对意大利可能对盟国参战的局面，在南市拦江浮栅上方的中立水域系泊，从而找到了安全之所。

由怡和洋行包租的“安巴·阿拉吉”号（s.s. Amba Alagi）轮向下移动，停泊在离“拉美西斯”号（s.s. Ramses）不远的地方。“拉美西斯”号是一艘德国轮船，因欧洲战争爆发而被困在港口，此后一直安全地停泊在黄浦江的中立部分。不远处停泊着目前由约翰·曼纳斯（John Manners）包租的“欣德塔”号（s.s. Hinderta）——该船于昨日向下移动——以及“帕多瓦掷弹兵”号（s.s. Granatiera Padova）。

意大利炮舰“埃马努埃莱·卡洛塔”号（Emanuele Carlotta）也向下移动，停泊在南市拦江浮栅内部。

“康特·韦尔德”号避开香港

劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司（Lloyd Triestino）的快速班轮“康特·韦尔德”号（Conte Verde）将从马尼拉直航上海，而不像往常那样停靠香港，这一事实进一步增强了人们认为意大利正准备参战的看法。

与此同时，同为中意轮船公司的“天津”号（s.s. Tientsin）停泊在浦东路对面，预计将于今天下午4时起锚，前往吴淞附近的镇江。

届时，意大利炮舰“勒班陀”号（The Lepanto）将成为唯一一艘悬挂意大利国旗、停泊在外滩以下黄浦江中立部分的船只。“勒班陀”号停泊在日本海军基地。

MAY 20 1940

Great Northern
Forced To Yield
Japan Interests

The Great Northern Telegraph Company on June 1 this year will cede all its rights in Japan to the Japanese Government, and will liquidate all its cables operated in the Japanese Empire until April 30, 1943, the Tokyo Government announced.

Immediately following the German occupation of Denmark, the Japanese Government brought pressure to bear upon the Danish Government and the company and enforced the opening of negotiations on the surrender of Great Northern's Japan interests. The negotiations were completed within less than six weeks, apparently in view of a Japanese threat to expropriate the Great Northern if no amicable agreement was reached.

The Great Northern Telegraph Company established its first cable at Nagasaki back in 1872, the first year of the Meiji Restoration, and has been operating a cable service with Japan ever since.

1940年5月20日

大北电报公司
被迫让步
日本利益

东京政府宣布，大北电报公司（Great Northern Telegraph Company）将于今年6月1日将其在日本的所有权利移交给日本政府，并清算其在日本帝国境内运营的所有电缆，直至1943年4月30日。

在德国占领丹麦后，日本政府立即向丹麦政府和该公司施加压力，强制开启关于移交大北公司在日利益的谈判。鉴于日本威胁若无法达成友好协议将没收大北公司资产，谈判在不到六周内完成。

大北电报公司于1872年（明治维新第一年）在长崎建立了第一条电缆，并自此一直与日本开展电缆服务业务。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
S. D.

MAY 2 / 1940

French Concession Tightening
Precautions: Power Stations.
Waterworks Heavily Guarded

Wholesale Expulsion Of German Residents
Denied; One Ousted In May For Booing
King George Picture On Screen

Precautionary measures have been tightened in the French
Concession although the authorities have not promulgated any
further orders affecting Germans residing in the area, a press
spokesman of the French Embassy here told The Shanghai
Evening Post this morning.
He denied rumors that recently many Germans living in
the French Concession had been ordered to leave.

Five Expelled
During the latter part of April
five Germans were expelled by
the French authorities because
they failed to maintain "neutral
residence" in accordance with
the decree issued at the outbreak
of the European war to the 400
German families living in the
French Concession.

Only one German since has
been ordered to leave the
French area by the end of this
month, it is learned. The reason
given for his expulsion is due
to the behavior during the
showing of "The Lion Has
Wings" at the Cathay Theatre
earlier this month, when the
German applauded the appear-
ance of Hitler on the screen,
but "booed" when King George
VI was shown.

Utilities Guarded
It was explained this morning
that the French authorities are
not in fear of any subversive

activities breaking out in the
Concession as constant precau-
tions have been maintained since
the outbreak of war in Europe.
Recently these precautions have
been strengthened and special
protective measures have been
taken at electricity generating
stations, fire stations, hospitals
and waterworks, which are being
guarded day and night.

Meanwhile, new recruits are
being added to the French Police
Specials to reinforce the regulars
now on duty. Recruiting is limit-
ed to Britons and Americans.
Members of the various depart-
ments of the French Municipal
Council now are working "war
hours," it is learned, many of
them putting in as many as
double the normal number of
hours. They may have to con-
tinue on this basis "for the dura-
tion" due to staff shortage result-
ing from enlistments in the
fighting forces.

R. H.

1940年5月2日

法租界加强预防措施：发电厂、水厂受到严密守卫

否认大规模驱逐德国居民；一人因在银幕上对乔治国王画像喝倒彩而于五月被驱逐

法国驻沪大使馆新闻发言人今晨告诉《上海晚邮报》，尽管当局尚未颁布任何影响居住在法租界德国人的进一步命令，但法租界内的预防措施已经加强。
他否认了近期许多居住在法租界的德国人被命令离开的谣言。

五人被驱逐
四月下旬，五名德国人被法国当局驱逐，原因是他们未能按照欧洲战争爆发时向居住在法租界的400个德国家庭发布的法令，维持“中立居住”状态。

据悉，截至本月底，只有一名德国人被命令离开法租界区域。据称，他被驱逐的原因是本月早些时候在大光明电影院（Cathay Theatre）放映电影《狮子有翅膀》（The Lion Has Wings）时的行为，当时这名德国人在希特勒出现在银幕上时鼓掌，而在乔治六世国王出现时则发出嘘声。

公用设施受到守卫
今晨解释说，法国当局并不担心租界内爆发任何颠覆活动，因为自欧洲战争爆发以来，一直保持着持续的预防措施。最近，这些预防措施得到加强，并在发电站、消防站、医院和水厂采取了特别的保护措施，这些地方日夜都有人守卫。

与此同时，正在招募新成员加入法国警察特别队（French Police Specials），以增援目前执勤的正规警员。招募对象仅限于英国人和美国人。据悉，法国公董局各部门的成员现在正按照“战时工作时间”工作，其中许多人投入的工作时间多达平时的两倍。由于应征入伍导致人员短缺，他们可能不得不在此基础之上“持续”工作。

R. H.

**〔印：COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 21 MAY 1943〕**

Night Duty Taken Over
French Police
Specials Here
Begin Patrols

Force : the French Special
Police, divided into four divisions,
began patrolling streets of the
French Concession last night, be-
ing vedly to insure their readiness in
case of any eventuality here.
The Specials will take four-day
shifts, each of the four divisions
patrolling the Concession one night
of the four, informed sources said.
Hours during which the patrols are
conducted are from 11 p.m. to 3
a.m.
At a meeting last night from 9
to 11 p.m., an inspection of the
Specials was conducted and in-
structions handed out. It was re-
ported that they were told to keep
their uniforms and guns in good
order and ready for action.
Semi-official French quarters said
that the patrolling order was a
routine one, and was made because
about 35 regular French Police
officers are leaving shortly for war
duty in Indo-China. Men from the
Specials are being trained to take
over their jobs, it was said.
However, other sources declared
that the Specials will soon take
over the entire night patrolling
duties of the regular Police.
Over 100 German members of the
Specials, including officers, were ex-
pelled from the group some time
ago. The gaps left by their absence
will be filled by replacements from
Allied nationals who may volunteer
for the service, it was believed.
The Specials are spread over
the whole of the Concession, with
five groups, assigned to five police
stations, represented.

D. C. (特别处)

**〔印：警务处处长办公室 1943年5月21日〕**

法国警察特别队
在此接管夜间勤务
开始巡逻

警力：法国警察特别队分为四个分队，昨晚开始巡逻法租界街道，此举旨在确保他们在应对任何突发事态时做好准备。
据知情人士透露，特别队将实行四天轮班制，四个分队中的每一个分队在四天中负责一晚的租界巡逻。巡逻时间为晚上11点至凌晨3点。
昨晚9点至11点举行了一次会议，对特别队进行了视察并下达了指令。据报道，他们被告知要保持制服和枪支的良好状态，随时准备行动。
法国半官方人士称，巡逻命令属于常规性质，这是因为大约35名法国正规警察军官即将前往印度支那执行战时任务。据悉，特别队成员正在接受培训，以接替他们的工作。
然而，其他消息来源声称，特别队很快将接管正规警察的全部夜间巡逻任务。
特别队中的一百多名德国成员（包括军官）已在不久前被驱逐出该队伍。据信，他们缺席留下的空缺将由可能自愿服役的盟国国民替补填补。
特别队遍布整个租界，设有五个小组，分别代表五个警察局。

page_data.en:
The colony at present is, of course, formed
by events in Finland. They have
caused the same stir brought about by
the outbreak of War in September
and the invasion of the former
Russian portions of Poland by Soviet
troops. But today the tension is even
higher, because every Russian politician
uses the events in Finland to test his
own theories on the future regime
and destinies of his country. And
what thinking Russian emigre does
not think of Russia nearly every day.
It should be noted that the unity of
opinion that has been evolved in the
large Russian colony in Paris does not
seem to be evidenced in Shanghai. In
Paris, judging from emigre news-
papers, all groups from the extreme
rightists, democrats and even social-
ists, and leftists, all nationals from the
"Latest News" (Posledniya Novosti)
of Prof P N Miliukoff, to leftists'
newspapers, "Resurrection" ("Vozroj-
denie") organ of the Russian nation-
alists, even the papers of the Mla-
dorossi who called themselves the
"Second Soviet Party"—all admit that
the place of Russian emigration lies
in coalition.
In the Russian Cathedral in Paris
a special religious service attended by
representatives of all emigre groups
and organizations was recently held
for Russian youths leaving for the
front with the French army. Mr.
Alexandre Kazem-Bek, head of the
Russian Mladorossi, has issued an
appeal to comrades in America to do
everything within their power to help
Russians fighting in the ranks of the
French Army.' In Shanghai there is
no such unity of mood and opinion.

Assessing Opinions
Of course it is always hard to as-
sess the main currents of opinion in
any large group of people when those
opinions do not take the form of
meetings or manifestations. How can
one know the political philosophy of
Ivan Ivanovitch when he stands
behind a shop counter all day or
guards a bank or godown throughout
the night? But it could be safely
said that the bare fact of repatriation
to Russia of the historical possessions
of the Russian Empire—whether it be
half of Poland up to Lord Curzon's
Line, or Bessarabia, or the former
Grand Duchy of Finland—does not
draw forth any protests.
Why should Russia renounce her
historical inheritance when not a
single government in the world is
willing to renounce its own, all the
more so as Russia lost millions of
her sons during the World War? But
whereas the pro-Soviet section obstin-
ately insists on that is happening in
the U.S.S.R., the other section of
emigration always draws a distinction
between the U.S.S.R. and Russia.
Russians know Finland well, and have
always loved the country.

Admiration of Finns
One went there for the summer and
on business trips, admired its Euro-
pean way of life and the diligence
and honesty of its people. Finland's
scenery and her fiords always delight-
ed Russians. Russian liberals were
not only opposed to the Russian
policy in Finland during the reign
of the last two Czars, but made pro-
tests and in many ways supported the
autonomous ambitions of the Finnish
intelligentsia.
During the Civil War many Rus-
sians found in Finland their first re-
fuge after their escape from Russia.
Many are of the opinion that, in spite
of the Kremlin's desires, the U.S.S.R.
will not be able to remain outside the
whirlpool of the European War,
which seems to be drawing her in-
exorably into its orbit; and no one
today can predict the final results of
the present truly historic develop-
ments.

目前，侨民社区当然因芬兰的局势而形成。这些事件引起了与九月战争爆发及苏军入侵前波兰的俄罗斯部分时同样的骚动。但如今的紧张局势甚至更高，因为每一位俄罗斯政客都利用芬兰的事件来检验自己关于国家未来政体和命运的理论。而有思想的俄罗斯流亡者，又有哪一位不是几乎每天都在思考俄罗斯呢？值得注意的是，在巴黎庞大的俄罗斯侨民群体中形成的舆论统一性，似乎并未在上海显现。在巴黎，根据流亡报纸的判断，从极右翼、民主派甚至社会党人和左翼人士，所有团体，从 P. N. 米留科夫（P N Miliukoff）教授的《最新消息报》（Posledniya Novosti）到左翼报纸，乃至俄罗斯民族主义者的机关报《复兴报》（"Vozrojdenie"），甚至是自称为“第二苏维埃党”的年轻俄罗斯人（Mladorossi）的报纸——都承认俄罗斯流亡者的出路在于联合。
最近在巴黎的俄罗斯大教堂举行了一场特别的宗教仪式，所有流亡团体和组织的代表均出席，为那些随法军前往前线的俄罗斯青年祈祷。俄罗斯年轻俄罗斯人（Mladorossi）领袖亚历山大·卡泽姆-贝克（Alexandre Kazem-Bek）先生已向美国的同志发出呼吁，要求他们竭尽全力帮助在法军行列中作战的俄罗斯人。而在上海，并没有这种情绪和意见的统一。

评估舆论
当然，当任何大型人群中的意见不以会议或示威的形式表现出来时，要评估其主要舆论流向总是很困难的。当伊万·伊万诺维奇（Ivan Ivanovitch）整天站在商店柜台后面，或者整夜守卫银行或仓库时，人们怎能知道他的政治哲学呢？但可以肯定地说，俄罗斯帝国的历史领土——无论是直到寇松线（Lord Curzon's Line）的一半波兰，还是比萨拉比亚，或是前芬兰大公国——被遣返回俄罗斯这一事实，并没有引发任何抗议。
既然世界上没有一个政府愿意放弃自己的历史遗产，俄罗斯又何必放弃她的历史继承权呢？更何况俄罗斯在世界大战期间失去了数百万子民？但是，虽然亲苏派顽固地坚持苏联境内正在发生的事情，但流亡群体的另一部分人总是将苏联与俄罗斯区分开来。俄罗斯人非常了解芬兰，并且一直喜爱这个国家。

对芬兰人的钦佩
人们去那里度夏和出差，欣赏其欧洲式的生活方式以及人民的勤奋和诚实。芬兰的风景和峡湾总是令俄罗斯人欣喜。俄罗斯自由派不仅反对最后两位沙皇统治时期俄罗斯在芬兰的政策，还提出抗议，并以多种方式支持芬兰知识分子的自治抱负。
在内战期间，许多俄罗斯人在逃离俄罗斯后，在芬兰找到了第一个避难所。许多人认为，尽管克里姆林宫有此愿望，但苏联将无法置身于欧洲战争的漩涡之外，这场战争似乎正无情地将其卷入其轨道；如今无人能预测当前真正具有历史意义的事态发展的最终结果。

French Here
Ban Permits

Trade Licenses To Be

JEWISH EMIGRES
HIT BY RULING

Nazi Intelligence Men
Said Masquerading As
Jewish Refugees

The French Municipal
Council will in future refuse
building permits and com-
mercial licenses to all Ger-
mans in the French Conces-
sion pending the investigation
of individual applicants by
the authorities, THE CHINA
PRESS learned yesterday.

While the authorities con-
cerned were reticent on this
subject yesterday, it was re-
ported that this measure was
enforced yesterday in circular
instructions to all departments
of the F.M.C. in an effort to
reduce the activity of the Ger-
man intelligence service in the
French Concession.

Blow To Refugees

The order as it stands at present
affects all persons with German
passports, whether they be Jewish
emigres or political refugees from
the Reich. However, the ban does
not intend that the innocent should
suffer, it was learned, and licenses
will be issued after individual cases
have been investigated and found
to be without ulterior motives.

More than all other Germans,
the measure will affect Shang-
hai's thousands of German-
Jewish refugees, who now, as in
the past, are opening many
businesses in Frenchtown. While
bona fide cases will ultimately
obtain the necessary permission
to trade in the French Conces-
sion, the delay which will be
caused by the investigation of
their true identities will be a
heavy blow to the emigres.

Espionage Suspected

It was pointed out that, much
as the authorities would like to
avoid placing obstacles in the way
of peaceful trading by German-
Jewish refugees, it was inadvertent
that they should suffer.

The French Municipal Council,
THE CHINA PRESS learned yesterday,
has solid grounds for suspecting
that numerous German members
of the intelligence service, have
had their passports stamped with
the glaring red "J" which desig-
nates German Jews, in order to
avert suspicion.

犹太流亡者

纳粹情报人员

《大美晚报》昨日获悉，法国公董局今后将拒绝向法租界内的所有德国人发放建筑许可证和商业执照，直至当局对个别申请人进行调查。

虽然有关当局昨日对此事保持沉默，但有报道称，昨日已通过通函指令向法公董局各部门执行了这一措施，旨在减少德国情报机构在法租界的活动。

对难民的打击

目前的命令影响所有持有德国护照的人，无论是犹太流亡者还是来自德国的政治难民。然而，据了解，禁令并非意在让无辜者受苦，在调查个别案件并发现其无其他动机后，将颁发执照。

与其他德国人相比，该措施将对上海的数千名德籍犹太难民产生影响，他们现在和过去一样，在法租界开设了许多商铺。虽然真实的个案最终将获得在法租界贸易所需的许可，但对其真实身份的调查所造成的延误将对流亡者造成沉重打击。

怀疑间谍活动

有人指出，尽管当局希望避免给德籍犹太难民的和平贸易设置障碍，但他们遭受损失是不可避免的。

《大美晚报》昨日获悉，法国公董局有充分理由怀疑，许多德国情报机构成员在其护照上盖有醒目的红色“J”字样（标识德国犹太人），以避开嫌疑。

French Council To Have No
Dealings With Germans

No Building Permits Or Licences Of Any Kind To
Be Granted In Concession To Holders Of
German Passports—Jews Or Christians

It was definitely announced yes-
terday by M J Brediam, Director-
General of the French Municipal
Council, that upon instructions from
the French Consul-General, the
French Council will have no deal-
ing whatsoever with Germans. No
building permits or commercial
licences whatsoever will be grant-
ed to holders of German passports,
be they Christians, Catholics, or
Jews.

"Can you blame us?" asked the
Director of the French Council,
when the question of German Jew-
ish Refugees was brought up. "We
are at war with Germany," he ex-
plained, "and we cannot start dis-
tinguishing between refugees and
others." M. Brediam pointed out
that the instructions to cease hav-
ing all dealings with German
nationals were issued by M. M.
Baudes, French Consul-General

here, upon instructions received
from Paris.

M. Brediam stated that he ap-
preciated the plight of the German
Jewish immigrants, whose passports
were marked with a large "J", but
pointed out that the whole matter
was too complicated to be dealt with
immediately. He would not com-
mit himself, however, on the point
of whether or not any special cases
of German Jewish Refugees would
be considered.

Blow To Refugees

The order of the French Council
comes as a blow to the large Ger-
man Jewish Refugee community,
some of whom were planning to
go into business in the Concession.
It is being hoped, however, that
ultimately the French Council will
grant permits and licences to bona
fide cases after investigations have
been made.

法国公董局不与德国人打交道

不向持德国护照者——无论是犹太人还是基督徒——在租界内发放任何建筑许可证或执照

法国公董局总干事 J. Brediam 先生昨日明确宣布，根据法国总领事的指示，法国公董局将不与德国人进行任何往来。无论持有人是基督徒、天主教徒还是犹太人，均不向其发放任何建筑许可证或商业执照。

“你能责怪我们吗？”当提到德籍犹太难民的问题时，法国公董局总监问道。“我们与德国处于战争状态，”他解释说，“我们无法开始区分难民和其他人。” Brediam 先生指出，停止与德国国民进行所有往来的指令是由驻此地的法国总领事 M. M. Baudes 先生根据从巴黎收到的指示发出的。

Brediam 先生表示，他理解德籍犹太移民的困境，他们的护照上标有一个大大的“J”，但他指出，整个问题过于复杂，无法立即处理。然而，他不愿就是否会考虑德籍犹太难民的特殊个案这一问题作出承诺。

对难民的打击

法国公董局的命令对庞大的德籍犹太难民社区是一个打击，其中一些人正计划在租界内经商。不过，人们希望法国公董局最终会在调查后向真实的个案发放许可证和执照。

POLICE

No. S. ____

Ministry of Information
Has Shanghai Office

Mr. R. H. Scott Serving as
Far Eastern Executive

An official spokesman said yesterday that Mr. R. H. Scott, assistant financial adviser to the British Embassy in China, is also serving as a representative of the Ministry of Information in the Far East indicating the importance attached by the British authorities to the publicity work and public opinion in this part of the world. Mr. Scott who arrived here last month from England is setting up branch offices of the Ministry in Tokyo and Shanghai with headquarters in Hongkong.

He will go to Tokyo and also Chungking in order to enable him to send a report to the Ministry regarding the public opinion in general in the Orient. It is understood that Mr Scott will also act as liaison officer between British diplomatic offices and the press so as to do away with misunderstandings that might be created by propaganda and to see to that the British view is properly represented.

The British government is studying various problems of the war relating to the Orient and other parts of the world and it has mobilized the whole Empire for a war of long duration. The Shanghai office of the Ministry of Information, situated at 27 the Bund, it is authoritatively learned, has already begun its work.

CHINESE OPINION IN EUROPE
IS URGED BY FORMER FOREIGN
MINISTER FOR CHINA
BY EUGENE CHEN

The following message was issued at Hongkong on the
occasion of the Double Tenth—EDITOR.

IN THE MIDST of the struggle with an enemy who e will
to conquer China is unweakened and not dispirited we
celebrate another anniversary of the National Revolution
which liberated us from alien domination that endured
for more than two and a half centuries. We shall retain
mastery of our destiny as a sovereign People if faith is not
lost in the principles that make
for victory when a nation is cir-
cumstanced as we are to-day: a
ruthless realism in finding out
the material and moral elements
of failure, knowledge and force of
mind to readjust policy and action
to the challenge of new factors
of environment, and realisation
that a modern war cannot be won
on the strength of Confucian pre-
cepts.

WITH THIS in mind, I direct
attention to the war in
Europe, pregnant with great
changes and vital issues which
will test the strength and search
the soul of nations. Because
China is within range of its im-
pact, it behoves us to ponder
gravely on what may come to
pass and try to plan for the
security of the Nation.
The war, with its energies, may
be canalised along three possible
lines of development. It may be
localised in Europe and confined
to Britain, France and Germany;
it may be generalised into a
world war, involving not only
these three Powers but Russia,
Italy, Japan and the United
States of America; or it may be
ended by the early conclusion of
peace.
If the war be restricted to
Britain, France and Germany,
British naval supremacy will
assure, this, together with Allied
Powers, especially if the war is
protracted. The conditions in the
past that made for the decisive-
ness of British sea-power con-
tinue to obtain, and there is no
reason why this testing of his-
tory will be falsified in the pre-
sent conflict. Indeed, the me-
chanisation of war increases the
validity of sea-power, particular-
ly where the field of operations is
in Europe. This continent (exclud-
ing Germany, Russia, etc.) is
self-sufficient in all the raw
materials necessary for industrial

victory in a mechanised war of
the magnitude of the present one.
While British seapower, reinforc-
ed by that of France and Allied
air-power, commands European
and other waters, some of the
vital materials of victory will not
reach the enemy. In a long war,
existing reserves of these
materials will be exhausted and
Allied seapower will prevent en-
emy replenishment.

SHOULD the struggle develop
and attain the dread dimen-
sions of a world war, the total
war-power of Britain, France and
the United States would dictate
the victory of Western democracy
irrespective of Russian, Italian or
Japanese action. Superior sea-
power enhanced by air-power,
which would be vested in Allied
and American hands, would be
the determinant of victory. This
certainty of ultimate Allied and
American victory would decide
the alignment of Italy and, pro-
bably, that of Japan as well as
the role to be played by Russia.
American participation with
Britain and France is a strategic
imperative, because an Allied de-
feat would transfer Allied sea-

America.

民主国家必将获胜
中国前外交部长敦促
欧洲的中国舆论
作者：陈友仁

以下讯息系于双十节之际在香港发布——编者按。

在与企图征服中国的敌人斗争的过程中，我们的意志并未减弱，士气也未低落，我们庆祝国民革命的又一个周年纪念日，这场革命将我们从持续了两个半世纪以上的外族统治中解放出来。如果一个民族处于像我们今天这样的境况，只要不丧失对致胜原则的信念，我们将保持作为主权人民对自己命运的掌控：这些原则包括以无情的现实主义去发现导致失败的物质和精神要素，具备知识和精神力量以根据环境新因素的挑战调整政策和行动，并认识到现代战争不能仅靠儒家信条的力量来赢得胜利。

鉴于此，我将注意力引向欧洲战争，这场战争孕育着巨大的变化和至关重要的问题，将考验各国的实力并审视其灵魂。由于中国处于其影响范围内，我们有必要认真思考可能发生的事情，并尝试为国家安全制定计划。
这场战争及其能量可能沿着三条可能的发展路线进行。它可能局限于欧洲，仅涉及英国、法国和德国；它可能演变为世界大战，不仅涉及这三个强国，还涉及俄罗斯、意大利、日本和美利坚合众国；或者它可能通过早日达成和平而结束。
如果战争仅限于英国、法国和德国，英国的海上霸权将确保这一点，盟国尤其是如果战争持久化，也将起到作用。过去造就英国海权决定性的条件依然存在，没有理由认为这一历史考验会在当前的冲突中被证伪。事实上，战争的机械化增加了海权的有效性，特别是在作战区域位于欧洲的情况下。这块大陆（不包括德国、俄罗斯等）在工业化所需的所有原材料方面是自给自足的，

THIS eventual outcome of the
war must be envisaged if
Chinese national opinion is not
to be misled by the belief in
certain Chinese circles that the
Allies may not win. This be-
lief is wrong and deeply
dangerous because the im-
plication is that since the Allies
may lose, it is advisable for China
to maintain neutrality. But a
policy of neutrality is precisely
the line of action prescribed by
Japan for the "Provisional
Government" at Peiping and the
"Reformed Government" at Nan-
king.
The reason is clear. A domin-
ant aim of Japanese policy is
politically to cut off and isolate
China from the West in order to
consummate Japan's domination
of China and impose on Britain,
France and other Powers the
view that the Japanese invasion
of China is a local "incident" to
be settled directly between Japan
and China. Should Japan succeed
in this purpose, the interna-
tional basis would be laid for the
consolidation of the invasion in a
later structure of conquest. Chin-
ese neutrality declared or undecl-
ared, would forward this basic
design of Japanese statecraft.
Since neutrality is thus unten-
able China must needs intervene
on the side of the Allied Powers
or on that of Germany. As the
latter will be defeated according
to the view expressed here, the
course of China is clear and in-
eluctable. She must define her
attitude in a declaration in favour
of the Allied Powers and range
herself against totalitarian auto-
cracy with its conception and
practice of lawless force as an in-
strument of national and inter-
national domination.

THERE ARE OTHER inexor-
able reasons which summon
China to pro-Allied intervention.
But certain considerations sug-

WHAT program of action do these considerations press us to formulate and carry out? If China is to intervene at all, not to be in idle talk, it must be implemented in the first instance by a rupture of diplomatic relations with Germany though, in order to avoid any question of the application to China of American neutrality legislation, a formal declaration of war between China and Germany should be deferred until Allied need of man-power reaches its own climax perhaps after the first year of fighting. The war is destined to cost the main body of Europe in spite of the economy in casualties which a defensive strategy is expected to yield.

In the meantime preparation can begin for the recruiting throughout China, of men for eventual service as workers, soldiers and seamen on the Western front in Europe and, in case the war spreads, on other fronts as well as on Allied shipping. With proper organization and Allied technical and other cooperation, a large expeditionary force of a million and more men could be gradually sent abroad without weakening the work of resistance to the invasion.

The speedy adoption of this policy of intervention is desirable in view of the historical experience of the Great War of 1914-18 when China delayed intervention until it was too late to prevent the then Allied Powers from concluding with Japan their secret pact concerning Shantung. A similar danger may well exist today regarding not only Shantung itself but the whole of China.

IT IS POSSIBLE that the Allied Powers might be embarrassed by, or might deprecate, Chinese intervention under obsession of the fear that Japan might attack their positions in "East Asia," including Hongkong and Indo-China. Whilst the continental enlargement of the Japanese Empire into a "New Order in East Asia" would be incomplete without the elimination of British and French Asiatic Powers, Japan would not dare to attack them unless she was convinced of Allied defeat in the European war. As long as the certainty of Allied victory remains a postulate of the European war situation, it will deter Japan's design in the Far East as it will determine her attitude towards the Axis powers.

SEP 1 8 1939

German Employees Of British
Firms In Manila Released

Mr. S. Wyatt-Smith, Consul-General for Britain in Manila, last week confirmed reports that most British establishments in the Philippines had discharged German employees as a result of the European war but, he added, "I did not order it."

Whatever action British employers have taken against Germans in their employ were "purely voluntary, probably arising from a sense of duty," according to the Consul-General. He said he had not received orders from the home government to take action against Germans here.

The Consul-General said his government had not yet ordered the enlistment of Englishmen in Manila. He admitted there have been a number of volunteers during the last few days. Those who volunteered had either sailed or would soon sail for England, most probably through the United States and Canada.

Among the first to volunteer for enlistment and the first to depart for England was David J. L. Broomfield. In a statement he issued for the League of Democracy, of which he is a member, he said in part: "No man is worthy to be called an Englishman unless he accepts the responsibilities of his birth."

With regard to preparations for taking care of possible British evacuees from China, Mr. Wyatt-Smith said the American Red Cross was taking care of all arrangements but that his office would be glad to co-operate if necessary.

According to records of the consulate there are about 1,000 British subjects in the Philippines, half of whom are British Indians.

提出这一要求的目的是防止发生任何不幸事件，以免某一交战国的好战成员对敌国国旗表示反对。此类事件已发生过一起：两面带有纳粹标志的德国国旗激怒了一名敌对者，导致旗帜被扯下，悬挂旗帜的德国网球俱乐部垫棚也被毁坏。

当地拥有德籍会员的各家英国和法国俱乐部的委员会正为其“敌国”会员的地位问题感到头疼。一些俱乐部考虑将这些人的名字从俱乐部记录和会员名册中除名，另一些则考虑将敌国会员列入某种暂停会员资格名单。

然而，许多英国俱乐部的德籍会员不再光顾这些俱乐部，这让各委员会松了一口气，因为尽管大多数会员很乐意在俱乐部再次与他们的德国朋友见面，但总有可能出现某些易冲动的好战分子惹出麻烦，这将极其令人不快且不幸。因此，受托人决定，如果俱乐部不悬挂国旗，那么在跑马厅拥有体育俱乐部的各国侨民之间引发事端的挑衅因素将会减少。

Reading The News

Shanghai Business And The War
Although the various local communities of the belligerents in Europe continue to live in Shanghai peacefully side by side local business connections between them and individuals of countries opposing each other, have been disrupted during the last two days to a large extent. British and French banks in Shanghai as a rule no longer are effecting payments to German firms and German subjects.

The local British Consul-General yesterday afternoon issued the Shanghai variety of the British Trading with the Enemy Law, which repeats and makes applicable in Shanghai the regulations issued a day earlier by the British Board of Trade for the United Kingdom. Under this law, trade and all other sorts of business not only with Germany but also with German subjects resident or carrying on business in China is being prohibited. British subjects are not to discharge any debt or to make other payments to German subject, nor are they to accept any payment from an enemy subject, unless, in the latter case, the transaction concerned has been completed prior to the outbreak of war between Germany and the United Kingdom.

The local French authorities have not issued any such regulations but it is understood that the French declaration of war upon Germany automatically implied the discontinuation of business with the enemy country and enemy subjects, so that in actual practice the French take the same attitude toward German business as do the British.

These proceedings however unavoidable, certainly are not to the advantage of Shanghai business as a whole, and disrupt many business relations which for long years have been profitable for both belligerent sides. It is to be hoped, and it is not unlikely, that the British and French Ambassadors in Shanghai will make a generous use of their powers of granting exceptions from the above general rules, and that the Germans will reciprocate in a similar sense of mitigating undue hardships.

Local foreign trade for the time being is at an almost complete standstill, due to the sudden interruption of the most important of Shanghai's shipping services. All British shipping with and between China ports has been stopped and, for the moment, British vessels have to stay where they are.

There are no large German vessels in Shanghai port. The Norddeutscher Lloyd Line's "Regensburg" and "Elbe" which were due in Shanghai around this time, are staying in Yokohama, which they are unlikely to leave at all. The next German vessel which was to arrive here from Europe this month was the Kulmerland of the Hamburg-America Line, which at present may be somewhere in the Indian Ocean between Ceylon and Singapore, or maybe not very far from Shanghai—who knows?

Goods for and from Shanghai are suffering an unexpected fate. The m.v. Jean Laborde of the Messageries Maritimes interrupted its voyage to Shanghai and returned to Hongkong. It is announced that the cargo for Shanghai aboard the Jean Laborde will be discharged at Saigon at shippers' and/or consignees' risk and expense. The British s.s. Canton of the P. & O. S.N. Co., which sailed from Shanghai with much cargo for Europe on August 15, has landed these goods at Bombay, in British India.

This interruption of foreign trade at present forms the chief argument for all those in Shanghai who are in possession of stocks of foreign goods to refuse price reductions which ought to result from the recent strengthening of the foreign exchange values of Chinese national currency. Frantic enquiries are being made on the part of importers from Europe as regards possibilities and conditions of substitute imports specially from the United States and other neutral countries of the western world, but also from Australia.

The strength of Chinese national currency for the time being has reduced the premium at which the local Chinese authorities issue ...

上海商业与战争
尽管在欧洲交战国在沪的各个本地社群继续和平共处，但在过去两天里，它们之间以及彼此敌对国家的个人之间的本地商业联系在很大程度上已被切断。上海的英法银行通常不再向德国公司和德国国民进行支付。

英国驻沪总领事于昨日下午发布了适用于上海的英国《对敌贸易法》版本，该版本重申并使英国商务部前一天为联合王国发布的条例在上海适用。根据该法律，不仅禁止与德国进行贸易和各类其他业务，也禁止与居住在中国或在中国经商的德国国民进行此类活动。英国国民不得向德国国民清偿任何债务或进行其他支付，也不得从敌国国民处接受任何支付，除非在后一种情况下，相关交易是在德国与联合王国爆发战争之前完成的。

法国地方当局尚未发布任何此类规定，但据悉，法国对德宣战自动意味着停止与敌国及敌国国民的商业往来，因此在实际操作中，法国方面对德国商业采取的态度与英国相同。

然而，这些举措虽然不可避免，但肯定不利于上海的整体商业，并破坏了许多多年来使交战双方均获利的商业关系。人们希望，且这并非不可能，英法驻沪大使将慷慨运用其权力，对上述一般规则给予例外许可，而德国方面也将以类似的方式予以回报，以减轻不必要的困难。

由于上海最重要的航运服务突然中断，本地的对外贸易目前几乎完全停滞。所有往返于中国港口之间及与中国港口往来的英国航运均已停止，目前英国船只必须停留在原地。

上海港内没有大型德国船只。北德意志劳埃德公司 (Norddeutscher Lloyd Line) 的“雷根斯堡”号 (Regensburg) 和“易北”号 (Elbe) 原定此时抵达上海，现正停泊在横滨，它们很可能根本不会离开那里。本月下一艘计划从欧洲抵达此处的德国船只是汉堡-美洲航运公司 (Hamburg-America Line) 的“库尔默兰”号 (Kulmerland)，该船目前可能位于锡兰和新加坡之间的印度洋某处，或者离上海不远——谁知道呢？

进出上海的货物正遭受意想不到的命运。法国邮船公司 (Messageries Maritimes) 的“让·拉博德”号机动船 (m.v. Jean Laborde) 中断了前往上海的航程并返回香港。据宣布，“让·拉博德”号上运往上海的货物将在西贡卸货，风险及费用由发货人和/或收货人承担。半岛东方轮船公司 (P. & O. S.N. Co.) 的英国蒸汽船“广东”号 (s.s. Canton) 于8月15日载着大量运往欧洲的货物从上海启航，已将这些货物卸在英属印度的孟买。

目前对外贸易的中断，构成了上海所有持有外国商品库存者拒绝降价的主要理由，尽管近期中国法币外汇价值的走强本应导致降价。进口商正疯狂地向欧洲方面查询，特别是从美国和其他西方中立国，以及从澳大利亚进行替代进口的可能性和条件。

Detained in Shanghai

The British Navy has eased the ban
on China coastal traffic by British
merchant vessels, it was reported
yesterday This does not affect the
larger liners, which are still being
held in port pending orders from the
naval authorities. Although the smal-
ler China coast ships are freed for
commerce, they are still operating
under the orders of the British Navy
and receive their sailing orders from
that source. The various shipping
companies have no advance informa-
tion as to the dates of departures of
their vessels, and have no communi-
cation with their ships.

First steamer to take advantage of
the lifted restrictions was the Jardine
ss. Esang which sailed at 6 p.m. yes-
terday for South China. Her exact
destination was not revealed. Mean-
while the two Canadian Pacific liners,
the Empress of Asia and the Empress
of Japan, are still in port with their
date of sailing unannounced. Offi-
cials of the company expected the
liners to sail last night, but they
were still in port up to a late hour.
It is possible that the Empress of
Asia may be allowed to proceed to
Hongkong, but the Empress of Japan,
scheduled to sail for Vancouver, may
be held here indefinitely.

Vessels Repainted Gray

The two Blue Funnel liners in the
harbour, the Teiresias and the Glen
Affric, are being painted a battleship
gray and in all probability will be
convoyed to Hongkong to be equipped
with armaments, it was learned yes-
terday.

Indicating that the British Navy is
already on the job of safeguarding
British merchant shipping in Far
Eastern waters, it was reported that
the Empress of Asia, while on her
way to Shanghai, was accompanied
by a British warship from the limits
of Japanese territorial waters to the
Saddles. When the liner reached the
Saddles the warship departed.

1939年9月6日

海军放宽对
沿海航运的禁令
“怡生”号蒸汽船驶往华南；大型邮轮仍被扣留在上海

据报道，英国海军已放宽对英国商船在中国沿海交通的禁令。这不影响大型邮轮，它们仍被扣留港口，等待海军当局的命令。虽然较小的中国沿海船只已获准进行商业运营，但它们仍在英国海军的命令下运作，并从该处接收航行指令。各航运公司对其船只的出发日期没有任何提前信息，也无法与其船只取得联系。

第一艘利用限制解除这一机会的蒸汽船是怡和洋行的“怡生”号 (ss. Esang)，它于昨日下午6点启航前往华南。其确切目的地未予透露。与此同时，加拿大太平洋公司的两艘邮轮，“亚细亚皇后”号 (Empress of Asia) 和“日本皇后”号 (Empress of Japan)，仍停在港口，启航日期未定。该公司官员原预计邮轮将于昨晚启航，但直到很晚它们仍停在港口。“亚细亚皇后”号可能会被允许前往香港，但计划驶往温哥华的“日本皇后”号可能会无限期地被扣留在此。

船只重新漆成灰色

据悉，港内的两艘蓝烟囱轮船公司 (Blue Funnel) 的邮轮，“忒瑞西阿斯”号 (Teiresias) 和“格伦阿弗里克”号 (Glen Affric)，正在被漆成战舰灰色，并且极有可能将在护航下前往香港以配备武器。

有报道表明，英国海军已经在着手保护远东水域的英国商船，“亚细亚皇后”号在前往上海的途中，从日本领海边界到马鞍群岛 (Saddles) 由一艘英国军舰陪同。当该邮轮到达马鞍群岛时，军舰离去。

载满乘客

据称护航舰队
正前来保护亚洲
航线出港

海军发言人
保持沉默

随着谣言四起，
格奈森瑙号（Gneisenau）
行踪之谜加深

英国海军当局今日在东方水域对其商船的安全不敢掉以轻心。虽然他们不认为中国海会有敌方潜艇出现的可能性，但也承认这种可能性存在，并继续禁止任何英国船只从上海启航。
两艘加拿大太平洋公司的豪华邮轮“日本皇后号”（Empress of Japan）和“亚洲皇后号”（Empress of Asia）已生火待发，跳板收起，整日焦急地等待海军部的航行命令。
所有原定随船离境的乘客被迫整天留在船上，不久之后，他们中间便流传起谣言，称英国军舰正从香港火速赶来担任护航任务。

“我们处于战争状态”

此地一位英国海军发言人在回答禁令何时解除以及沿海航运是否会由定期护航队护送的问题时，回答说：“我们现在处于战争状态，此类报告自然必须保密。”他们既不证实也不否认这些报道。
即使是像盟国军舰俘获德国商船这样戏剧性的公告，未来也不会从这位海军发言人口中得知。他说：“如果我们披露此类事件，不仅会使我们要舰的位置被敌方潜艇知晓，其他在同一航线上航行的德国商船也会听到风声，从而逃脱我们的行动网。”
意大利劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司（Lloyd Triestino）的官员们昨日松了一口气，因为他们能够宣布快速邮轮“朱利奥·凯撒号”（Giulio Cesare）将于9月8日启程前往意大利。不过，这一日期取决于罗马方面的确认。该公司的“孔特”号（Conte）**〔此处转录不清〕**

Gneisenau Returns
The German Nord Deutscher
Lloyd liner Gneisenau which re-
cently left Bremen Shanghai bound
with a load of Jewish refugees was
reported by the agents here to have
returned to its home port in safety.
The Potsdam of the same
company was also reported by
officials to have returned safely
to Bremen, but considering that
the ship was in the Indian
Ocean a few days ago its return
to Germany in so short a space
would be a geographic impossi-
bility. With a number of Ger-
man refugees and three mem-
bers of the Shanghai Municipal
Police force aboard the ship
may be bound for some neutral
South American port.
The mystery ship of the East,
however, is the Scharnhorst which
left Shanghai August 21. On the
first rumor of war the vessel stayed
on at Manila. When she left the
Philippine port a few days ago
minus a large number of passengers,
she was variously reported steaming
full speed towards the some neutral
Dutch East Indian port and safely
arrived in Kobe.

格奈森瑙号返回
据此地代理商报告，德国北德意志劳埃德公司（Nord Deutscher Lloyd）的邮轮“格奈森瑙号”（Gneisenau）近期满载犹太难民离开不来梅驶往上海，现已安全返回其母港。
据官员报告，该公司的另一艘船“波茨坦号”（Potsdam）也已安全返回不来梅，但考虑到该船几天前还在印度洋，如此短的时间内返回德国在地理上是不可能的。鉴于船上有数名德国难民和上海公共租界警务处的三名成员，该船可能正驶往某个南美洲的中立港口。
然而，东方的神秘船只却是8月21日离开上海的“沙恩霍斯特号”（Scharnhorst）。在战争谣言初起时，该船停留在马尼拉。几天前它离开菲律宾港口时，大量乘客未随行，各方报道说法不一，有的称其全速驶向某个荷属东印度的中立港口，有的称其已安全抵达神户。

CHINA DAILY NEWS

SEP 6 '39

Another "Bunder"
Typical of the manner in which alarmist
rumours are given currency in these days was
the story which found rapid currency yesterday
to the effect that the Butterfield & Swire s.s.
Anking had been torpedoed off Luzon Island.
The story was broadcast from Manila, and given
credence which it should not have received. It
may have been possible for the Germans to
have sent out a submarine to the Far East but
extremely unlikely, and if they had not done
so who else could possibly have done such a
thing? Fortunately it was quickly discovered
that the story was completely untrue, that the
Anking had been contacted and her location
ascertained. The tale appears to have gained
currency because for the moment British ship-
ping has been held up along the China coast.
That is a normal precaution until it has been
ascertained what has become of all German
vessels which might be capable of being trans-
formed into commerce raiders. If there are
indeed any in these waters it will be obviously
necessary for the British navy to do a little
mopping up to remove the threat which their
presence would create. The experiences of the
last war do not suggest that any very great
length of time would be necessary either to
find and destroy commerce raiders to make
sure that they would seek refuge in ports
where they would have to be interned. It was
also found that once such menaces were found-
ed up, there was no further cause for uneasi-
ness in this part of the world. Without making
any call upon the Grand Fleet there is ap-
parently in eastern waters all the strength
necessary to ensure that these seas shall be
kept free from any danger which commerce
raiders would present, and it may be confident-
ly expected that, in a comparatively short
while, normal commercial traffic will again be
possible in this part of the world. While it is
true that German submarines have a cruising
radius which would enable them to cross the
Atlantic as they did in the last war, there is
nothing at present to indicate that Germany
has anything which would make the lengthy
trip to the Far East, especially as the vessel
would have to travel by the Cape of Good
Hope if it were to avoid early detection.

《大美晚报》

1939年9月6日

又一个“邦德”谣言
恐慌性谣言在这些日子里传播的方式很典型，昨天迅速流传的一个故事就是例证，声称怡和洋行（Butterfield & Swire）的“安庆号”（Anking）轮船在吕宋岛附近被鱼雷击中。这个故事从马尼拉广播出来，并获得了本不该有的信任。德国人有可能派遣潜艇到远东，但这极不可能，如果他们没这么做，还有谁可能做这种事呢？幸运的是，人们很快发现这个故事完全不实，“安庆号”已被联系上，其位置也已确定。这个故事之所以流传，似乎是因为目前英国航运在中国沿海暂时停滞。这是一种正常的预防措施，直到查明所有可能被改装为商业袭击舰的德国船只的下落。如果这些水域确实有这样的船只，英国海军显然需要进行一些扫荡行动，以消除它们的存在所造成的威胁。上一次战争的经验表明，并不需要很长时间就能找到并摧毁商业袭击舰，或者确保它们寻求避难于必须被扣留的港口。还发现，一旦这类威胁被肃清，世界这一地区就不再有不安全的理由。无需调动主力舰队，东部水域显然拥有必要的力量，以确保这些海域免受商业袭击舰带来的任何危险，可以自信地预期，在相对较短的时间内，世界这一地区的正常商业交通将再次成为可能。虽然德国潜艇的巡航半径确实使它们能够像上次战争那样穿越大西洋，但目前没有任何迹象表明德国拥有能够进行到远东长途旅行的船只，特别是如果为了避免早期被发现，船只必须绕道好望角的话。

Local Czechoslovakian Society
Expels Pro-German Members

Last night at 8 o'clock a meet-
ing of the Czechoslovak Krouyek
(Political and Social Circle) was
held at their premises in Rue
Bourgeat, which was attended by
more than 100 members.
The first resolution adopted was
the expulsion of all Czechoslova-
kians who had surrendered their
passports to the local German Con-
sulate, thereby acknowledging the
sovereignty of the Reich. It is
understood that these only number-
ed eight.
It was then unanimously resolved
that all loyal Czechoslovakians
should unreservedly offer their ser-
vices to Great Britain and France
and all those present signed their
names to this resolution. Identical
letters to the British and French
Ambassadors in Shanghai are being
forwarded today which will form-
ally place the services of every
signatory of the resolution at their
disposal, in whatever capacity may
be decided upon.
A cable to President Benes in
London was then drafted, express-
ing the loyal sentiments of those
present and their heartfelt thanks
for all the President had done for
their country.
The National Anthems of Great
Britain, France, the United States
and Czechoslovakia were then
played and the meeting was con-
cluded amidst scenes of the great-
est enthusiasm.

当地捷克斯洛伐克社团
开除亲德成员

昨晚8点，捷克斯洛伐克克鲁耶克社（Krouyek，政治社交圈）在其布尔热阿路（Rue Bourgeat）的会所举行会议，有100多名成员出席。
通过的第一项决议是开除所有向当地德国领事馆交出护照、从而承认帝国主权的捷克斯洛伐克人。据悉，这些人仅有八名。
随后一致决议，所有忠诚的捷克斯洛伐克人应无条件向英国和法国提供服务，所有在场者都在该决议上签了名。致驻上海英国和法国大使内容相同的信件今日正在发出，这将正式把每一位决议签署者的服务置于他们的支配之下，无论决定以何种身份效力。
随后起草了一份发给伦敦贝内斯总统的电报，表达了在场者的忠诚情感，并对总统为国家所做的一切表示衷心感谢。
随后演奏了英国、法国、美国和捷克斯洛伐克的国歌，会议在极其热烈的场面中结束。

SEP 7, 1939

Tokyo Asks Troops
Here Withdrawn

Consuls Told Fears of
Friction ; Ambassador to
Consult Foreign Office

Tokyo, Sept 6.
The Japanese Government has proposed that the British, French, Polish and German forces at present in China should all be withdrawn.
The reason for the Japanese proposal, which has it is understood, been made to the British, French, Polish and German Diplomatic representatives in Tokyo, is stated to be "in order to avoid incidents."
It is learned that the British Ambassador, Sir Robert Craigie, in acknowledging the Japanese proposal, pointed out that there were no German troops in China and that therefore there was no likelihood of any incidents.
It is understood, however, that the matter will be reported to the Foreign Office in London before the British take a final decision in the matter.--Reuter.

Consul-General Calls
Mr. Yoshiaki Miura, Japanese Consul-General, yesterday visited M. Bauder, French Consul-General; Sir Herbert Phillips, H.M. Consul-General; and Mr. M. Fischer, German Consul-General, at 3.30 p.m., 4 and 5 p.m., respectively, and explained the policy of the Japanese Government of non-involvement in the present European war as announced by Gen. Nobuyuki Abe, Premier, on Monday.
At the same time Mr. Miura conveyed to his colleagues the grave concern of the Japanese Government over the attitude of the Powers towards the "China Incident," and requested the deliberate consideration of the belligerent Powers in order to eliminate such causes as are likely to give rise in China to untoward incidents among them.
Mr. Miura also visited the Consuls-General of the United States and Italy, who are remaining neutral at present, and informed them of the above effect for their reference.

Japanese Navy's Request
At yesterday's press conference the naval spokesman issued the following communique:--Rear Admiral Kusaki, Chief of Staff of the Japanese China Seas Fleet, yesterday visited the senior officers of the British and French men-of-war in Shanghai, on behalf of Admiral Oikawa, C.-in-C. of the Japanese Fleet, and requested that the commanders should comply with the request of the Japanese Government, which was communicated to the belligerent powers in Tokyo on Tuesday.
"What was the nature of the request of the Japanese Government?" enquired a correspondent. In reply it was stated that the communication asked that all chances of friction should be eliminated. Pressed for details, the spokesman said that, 'aware of them,' he was unable to disclose them.
It was then asked if the British and French warships were asked to withdraw from China waters and, replying, the spokesman said that the Japanese navy could employ the necessary steps one by one, but he did not know the nature of the steps.

（批：7/9.）

1939年9月7日

东京要求
撤走在此的军队

告知领事担心
发生摩擦；大使将
咨询外交部

东京，9月6日。
日本政府提议，目前在中国的所有英国、法国、波兰和德国军队都应撤走。
据悉，已向驻东京的英国、法国、波兰和德国外交代表提出了这项日本提案，其理由据称是“为了避免事件发生”。
据悉，英国大使罗伯特·克雷吉爵士（Sir Robert Craigie）在回复日本提案时指出，中国没有德国军队，因此不太可能发生任何事件。
然而，据悉在英国就此事项做出最终决定之前，此事将报告给伦敦外交部。--路透社。

总领事拜访
日本总领事三浦义明（Yoshiaki Miura）先生昨日下午3时30分、4时和5时分别拜访了法国总领事博德尔（Bauder）先生、英国总领事赫伯特·菲利普斯爵士（Sir Herbert Phillips）和德国总领事费舍尔（M. Fischer）先生，并解释了首相阿部信行将军周一宣布的日本政府不卷入当前欧洲战争的政策。
同时，三浦先生向其同僚传达了日本政府对列强对待“中国事变”态度的严重关切，并请交战国慎重考虑，以消除那些可能在中国引起列强间不幸事件的起因。
三浦先生还拜访了目前保持中立的美国和意大利总领事，并将上述情况告知他们以供参考。

日本海军的要求

SHANGHAI TIMES

SEP 8 1939

COUNCIL'S ATTITUDE ON
ENLISTMENT

The attitude of the Shanghai Municipal Council regarding its employees who may wish to enlist for active service with the forces of their own countries is the only one which could be taken, in view of the Council's international composition and status, though the ruling will undoubtedly have come as a disappointment to many. If a Council employee desires to proceed home to join up he will first of all have to resign his position with the Council giving the usual six months' notice, will have to find his own way to some point at which he could be accepted as a recruit for active service, and will not have his job kept open for him against the day of his possible return. The Council took an entirely different attitude in the Great War 25 years ago. At that time men who could be spared were not only released to proceed overseas, but were credited with half pay all the while they were away, had their positions available when they returned after the war and were able to collect the funds which had accumulated to their credit. In the different circumstances which exist in Shanghai to-day such a procedure would be directly at variance with the best interests of both the Council and the general community. The Council must maintain its international aspect and, furthermore, keep the municipal service going at a time when suitable recruitment would be extremely difficult. The more one examines the matter and the problem which the Council has had to face in connection with it, the more does it become apparent that the Administration could not, safely and correctly, take any other decision. The temporary suspension of long leaves for those nationals whose countries are at war is also a well-justified decision, especially as the view of the local British authorities is that, for the time being, Britons in Shanghai are doing more good by remaining at their posts than by proceeding overseas. When one remembers that the only front upon which both Britain and France are engaged against Germany at the moment is the short Franco-German border between Switzerland and Luxemburg—a distance of approximately 300 miles—it is obvious that the combined man-power of the allied land forces is greatly excessive to requirements, especially in view of the fact that the border is a mass of modern fortifications on both sides. It remains to be seen how the war develops, but for the time being Britain and France would appear to have a large surplus of troops for the size of the one and only theatre in which they can act. 工部局对征募入伍的态度

鉴于上海公共租界工部局的国际组成及其地位，工部局对于希望加入本国军队服现役的雇员所采取的态度，是唯一可行的态度，尽管这一规定无疑会让许多人感到失望。如果一名工部局雇员希望回国参军，他首先必须辞去在工部局的职务，并按惯例提前六个月通知；必须自行设法前往某个能被接纳为现役新兵的地点；并且工部局不会为其保留职位以待其可能归来之日。在25年前的第一次世界大战期间，工部局采取了截然不同的态度。当时，那些可以抽身的人员不仅获准前往海外，而且在离家期间仍享有半薪，战后返回时其职位依然保留，并能够领取累积在其名下的款项。鉴于当今上海所处的不同环境，此种做法将直接违背工部局及广大公众的最佳利益。工部局必须保持其国际面貌，此外，在合适人员招募极其困难的时期，必须维持市政服务的运转。对此事及工部局不得不面对的相关问题进行越深入的审视，就越明显地看出，行政当局无法安全且正确地做出其他任何决定。暂时中止那些所属国处于战争状态的国籍员工的长假，也是一项理由充分的决定，尤其是因为当地英国当局的观点是，目前英国人在上海坚守岗位比前往海外能发挥更大的作用。人们只需记住，目前英法两国对德作战的唯一战线是瑞士与卢森堡之间短暂的法德边境——距离约为300英里——这就显而易见，盟军陆军的综合人力远远超过需求，特别是考虑到该边境两侧均布满了现代化防御工事。战争如何发展尚待观察，但目前看来，就英法两国唯一能采取行动的这一个战区的规模而言，它们似乎拥有大量的兵力 surplus。在第一次世界大战中，从战争爆发到英国认为有必要实行征兵制，历时超过一年，而且……

page_data.en:
There are, of course, numbers of men
who rightly feel that with their country
at war it is their duty to hasten to join
up, and to these there is only praise-
worthy acknowledgment to be made of
their patriotic desires. As nothing is
being done officially to assist Britons
wishing to enlist and as there are no
doubt men who are not in a position to
pay their own way, the suggestion has
been made by a correspondent that some-
thing be done in the way of organizing a
fund by which those desirous of going to
England to enlist could be assisted on their
way. Views on this matter are requested,
and if any letters are addressed to the
correspondent who signs himself "Buck,"
care of the Editor of this journal, they
will be gladly forwarded to the right
destination. For ourself, we incline to the
view that there is no need for haste in
the matter, except perhaps to organize
whatever machinery and finances might be
desirable later on. Britain and France
have all the men under arms which they
require and unless there should come
some further and at present unforeseen
developments in the situation it is better
not to overload the authorities at home or
to denude Shanghai of its employed man-
power. No-one can say, of course, what
the future holds for us all. It is
extremely difficult to see just how the
unfoldment of this great drama will
proceed, who might eventually be drawn
into active participation, or just where it
will be desirable to have forces available.
We are in the very early days of hostili-
ties which are still only slowly develop-
ing.
page_data.zh: 当然，有许多人 rightly 认为，在国家处于战争状态时， hasten 入伍是他们的责任，对于这些人的爱国愿望，只能给予值得称赞的认可。由于官方并未采取任何措施协助希望入伍的英国人，而且无疑有些人无力支付自己的旅费，因此有一位通讯员建议，应当组织一项基金，以资助那些希望前往英国入伍的人上路。现征求对此事的意见，如有信件寄给署名为“Buck”的通讯员，由本刊编辑转交，我们将乐意将其转送至正确的目的地。就我们而言，我们倾向于认为，此事无需匆忙，除非或许是为了日后组织任何可能需要的机制和资金。英国和法国已经拥有了它们所需的所有武装人员，除非局势出现进一步且目前无法预见的发展，否则最好不要给国内当局增加负担，也不要使上海缺乏受雇的人力。当然，没有人能说未来等待着我们的是什么。很难看清这场宏大戏剧将如何展开，谁最终可能被卷入积极参与，或者在何处部署兵力将是可取的。我们正处于敌对行动的初期阶段，而这些行动仍在缓慢发展中。
